name: dashform
description: Build, publish, and operate Dashform AI forms from Codex. Connects the Dashform MCP server (getaiform.com) and adds form-building workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, publish, score, and operate AI forms
interface.longDescription: Dashform turns your coding agent into a full operator for your form stack. Describe a form in plain language and it is created, refined, and published with a shareable link; AI lead-scoring criteria are suggested and applied; replies are triaged with natural-language analytics; and submissions flow into Slack, HubSpot, Airtable, Mailchimp, Zapier, or webhooks. Org admins can manage branding, email configuration, and custom domains without opening the dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Create a lead qualification form for my agency
Show me insights from my latest form replies
Send new form replies to a Slack channel
